request.style: English, female smooth voice, solo, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, muted trumpet, warm and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Examined for a good deed done today
A crippled man now healed and stands up straight
Let it be known to all of Israel
By the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth

[Chorus]
Whom you crucified and God raised from the dead
This man stands before you fully healed
He is the stone you builders rejected
Now the cornerstone where our hope is met

[Verse]
There is salvation in no one else
No other name under heaven given to men
By which we must be saved from our sin
The council sees their boldness is real

[Chorus]
Whom you crucified and God raised from the dead
This man stands before you fully healed
He is the stone you builders rejected
Now the cornerstone where our hope is met

[Bridge]
Amazed by ordinary men who knew Jesus
Seeing the healed man they have no reply
Ordered to leave and confer together
The truth remains for the world to see

[Chorus]
Whom you crucified and God raised from the dead
This man stands before you fully healed
He is the stone you builders rejected
Now the cornerstone where our hope is met

[Outro]
No other name under heaven
By which we must be saved
